company.description: Flagship enables creators to set up their own curated boutiques, without having to deal with inventory, customer service, or sales tax. The company allows the cultural leaders of today to create their online boutiques, which we refer to as their Flagship shop. This platform serves as a space where they can effortlessly connect with their preferred brands to discover the finest products for their communities and receive a fair commission for each sale they generate.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,184,429 to $18,903,258, a 2.06x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 3 (+2 over 90 days) and market heat at 59 (+0).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
